**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The RadialSpark agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Clear Capital, satisfying the preferred position. Two provisions warranted a closer look but neither triggers this rule:

| Provision | Assessment |
|---|---|
| § 13 Non-Solicitation (p0047) | Mutual, employee-only, 1 year, consent not unreasonably withheld — a personnel non-solicit, not a non-compete; binds both parties equally |
| § 4(b)(ii) (p0020) | Limits our reuse of *Contractor's* own pre-existing IP — a license-scope term, not a restraint on our business or products |

One note for your broader review, outside this rule's scope: the p0020 language ("shall not resell or make use of said property in any other manner other than in connection with the software Company receives under this Agreement") is a fairly tight leash on Contractor's Information, and it sits in tension with the broad perpetual license granted in § 4(c) (p0021) to use Contractor's Information "in connection with Company's business operations." That inconsistency is worth resolving under the IP/license-scope rule, since the narrower p0020 wording could be read to cut back the § 4(c) grant.
